description.value:
Acquired corporeal undead template. Apply d12 Hit Dice, undead type, retained or altered attacks, unholy toughness, abilities, good saves, and challenge rating equal to Hit Dice plus two, per printed pages 114-115.

This reusable record defines shared conversion behavior. Individual actors carry exact printed exceptions and totals.

system.source: World of Warcraft: Monster Guide, pp. 114-115
